g.title: AMI_QSP
g.text: Acute Myocardial Infarction (STEMI) — QSP Mechanistic Map
Acute myocardial infarction (ST-elevation myocardial infarction) · Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map
Coronary thrombosis · transmural wavefront of necrosis · reperfusion injury (mPTP · succinate · pH paradox) · microvascular obstruction (no-reflow) ·
innate immune healing · scar formation · Laplace wall-stress remodelling · neurohormonal axis · antiplatelet/fibrinolytic/GDMT pharmacokinetics–pharmacodynamics
Central claim: two races (wavefront vs. clock; acid washout vs. oxidant burst) and one bifurcation (wall stress ⇄ dilation).

g.text: sets the time of death of each layer

g.text: = territory supplied by the occluded vessel

g.text: washout = abrupt pH recovery → NHE runaway

g.text: pH paradox — washout takes the protection away
(the treatment is itself the second hit)

g.text: ② the deficit is the speed of the wavefront

g.title: REOX->PHPARA
g.text: ③ flow returns = acid washed out = gate opened

g.text: ④ the necrosis reperfusion makes for itself

g.text: ⑤ infarct size is not an endpoint but an initial condition

g.text: (the AUC reads size, the peak reads reperfusion)
